name: trello-link-check
description: Github action checking existence of Trello link in Pull Request description

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=lib/main.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);"
